original_record.question:
Carina has started to draw a cat. <image1> She then adds some eyes. Which picture could show her finished drawing?
<image2>
original_record.subject: combinatorial geometry

inventory.image1: blue-outlined oval cat head, two blue pointed ears with sloping white insets and small downward blue triangular nose, no eyes
inventory.image2: five finished cats with blue quadrilateral eyes and pale mouth arcs; A elongated raised nose, B preserves original nose/ears, C shallower ear insets, D up-pointing nose,E circular nose

answer_verification.method: Adding eyes cannot alter existing ear insets or nose. B preserves both exactly. A changes nose length/location, C changes ear insets, D reverses nose, E replaces triangle by circle. Shared added pale mouth curves are retained as in all source candidates.

audit.explicit_conditions_vs_layout: Geometry and option identity preserved. Locations and panel spacing are display layout only.
